fx-aputure-amaran-pt1c.page: DMX spec Modes 7-14 (PT1c/PT2c/PT4c columns, pp. 13-18); pixel counts and sizes from help.aputure.com amaran Pixel Tubes 'Photometrics & Technical Specifications' (Pixel Mapping PT1C 4 / PT2C 8 / PT4C 16; 42 mm diameter x 300 / 600 / 1200 mm).
fx-aputure-amaran-pt1c.orientation: Lying horizontal, control panel / USB-C end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-aputure-amaran-pt1c.notes: 4 pixels over 300 mm; 2-cell mode drawn as halves. Aputure does not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel/USB-C end is assumed.

fx-aputure-amaran-pt2c.page: DMX spec Modes 7-14 (PT1c/PT2c/PT4c columns, pp. 13-18); pixel counts and sizes from help.aputure.com amaran Pixel Tubes 'Photometrics & Technical Specifications' (Pixel Mapping PT1C 4 / PT2C 8 / PT4C 16; 42 mm diameter x 300 / 600 / 1200 mm).
fx-aputure-amaran-pt2c.orientation: Lying horizontal, control panel / USB-C end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-aputure-amaran-pt2c.notes: 8 pixels over 600 mm; 2- and 4-cell modes drawn as equal runs of 4 and 2. Aputure does not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel/USB-C end is assumed.

fx-aputure-amaran-pt4c.page: DMX spec Modes 7-14 (PT1c/PT2c/PT4c columns, pp. 13-18); pixel counts and sizes from help.aputure.com amaran Pixel Tubes 'Photometrics & Technical Specifications' (Pixel Mapping PT1C 4 / PT2C 8 / PT4C 16; 42 mm diameter x 300 / 600 / 1200 mm).
fx-aputure-amaran-pt4c.orientation: Lying horizontal, control panel / USB-C end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-aputure-amaran-pt4c.notes: 16 pixels over 1200 mm; 2-, 4- and 8-cell modes drawn as equal runs of 8, 4 and 2. Aputure does not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel/USB-C end is assumed.

fx-aputure-infinibar-pb12.page: help.aputure.com INFINIBAR 'Overview' (PB3 24, PB6 48, PB12 96 pixels; 'Over DMX, it [PB12] has 48 controllable pixels') and 'Photometrics & Technical Specifications' (30.4 / 60.4 / 120.4 x 4.5 cm); DMX spec Modes 9-41 list 4-48 pixel modes for all lengths.
fx-aputure-infinibar-pb12.orientation: Lying horizontal, LED face to the viewer, control panel end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-aputure-infinibar-pb12.notes: Drawn as the 48 DMX-controllable segments Aputure states for DMX (96 physical pixels, so each segment is 2 adjacent pixels); 32 cells do not split 48 segments evenly, so the 32-cell mode is left out. Aputure does not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel end is assumed.

fx-aputure-infinibar-pb3.page: help.aputure.com INFINIBAR 'Overview' (PB3 24, PB6 48, PB12 96 pixels; 'Over DMX, it [PB12] has 48 controllable pixels') and 'Photometrics & Technical Specifications' (30.4 / 60.4 / 120.4 x 4.5 cm); DMX spec Modes 9-41 list 4-48 pixel modes for all lengths.
fx-aputure-infinibar-pb3.orientation: Lying horizontal, LED face to the viewer, control panel end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-aputure-infinibar-pb3.notes: 24 pixels over 304 mm; only the 4/6/8/12/24-cell modes split 24 pixels evenly, so 16/32/48 are left out (Aputure does not say how a PB3 handles them). Aputure does not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel end is assumed.

fx-aputure-infinibar-pb6.page: help.aputure.com INFINIBAR 'Overview' (PB3 24, PB6 48, PB12 96 pixels; 'Over DMX, it [PB12] has 48 controllable pixels') and 'Photometrics & Technical Specifications' (30.4 / 60.4 / 120.4 x 4.5 cm); DMX spec Modes 9-41 list 4-48 pixel modes for all lengths.
fx-aputure-infinibar-pb6.orientation: Lying horizontal, LED face to the viewer, control panel end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-aputure-infinibar-pb6.notes: 48 pixels over 604 mm; 32 cells do not split 48 pixels evenly, so the 32-cell mode is left out. Aputure does not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel end is assumed.

fx-aputure-mt-pro.page: DMX spec Modes 9-26; help.aputure.com MT Pro 'DMX Profiles & Settings' / FAQ: '36 pixels ... DMX profiles that bundle the pixels into groups of 2, 3, 4, 6, and 9'; size 30.0 x 4.0 x 3.5 cm from 'Photometrics and Technical Specifications'.
fx-aputure-mt-pro.orientation: Lying horizontal, LED face to the viewer, control panel / USB-C end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-aputure-mt-pro.notes: 36 pixels over 300 mm, grouped in runs of 9/6/4/3/2 as Aputure states. Aputure does not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel/USB-C end is assumed.

fx-arri-skypanel-s120c.page: p. 53 of 88, 'Individual Light Engine Control - Light Engine Numbering'
fx-arri-skypanel-s120c.orientation: Front view (spec: 'Light engine positions seen from the front'), landscape as drawn; the spec does not mark which edge is the top
fx-arri-skypanel-s120c.notes: The S120-C diagram shows 4 light engines in a 4x1 grid numbered left to right; LE 1 is the left end seen from the front. Aspect is as drawn (square engine boxes).

fx-arri-skypanel-s360c.page: p. 53 of 88, 'Individual Light Engine Control - Light Engine Numbering'
fx-arri-skypanel-s360c.orientation: Front view (spec: 'Light engine positions seen from the front'), landscape as drawn; the spec does not mark which edge is the top
fx-arri-skypanel-s360c.notes: The S360-C diagram shows 12 light engines in a 4x3 grid numbered left to right, top row first; LE 1 is top-left seen from the front. Aspect is as drawn (square engine boxes).

fx-arri-skypanel-s60c.page: p. 53 of 88, 'Individual Light Engine Control - Light Engine Numbering'
fx-arri-skypanel-s60c.orientation: Front view (spec: 'Light engine positions seen from the front'), landscape as drawn; the spec does not mark which edge is the top
fx-arri-skypanel-s60c.notes: The S60-C diagram shows 2 light engines in a 2x1 grid numbered left to right; LE 1 is the left end seen from the front. Aspect is as drawn (square engine boxes).

fx-arri-skypanel-x21.page: SkyPanel X DMX Protocol V6.0: p. 13 (8 Zone Mode RGB 'Zone definition'), p. 16 (16 zone), pp. 20-21 (24 zone); array numbering also in SkyPanel X User Manual v1.1 p. 37
fx-arri-skypanel-x21.orientation: Front view ('seen from the front of the fixture'), landscape, yoke arms at the left and right ends as drawn
fx-arri-skypanel-x21.notes: Zone 1 is top-left; the 4 light engines (2x2) are each split into a left and right zone, giving 4 columns x 2 rows numbered left to right, top row first. 16 and 24 zone modes span an X22/X23 array: per the spec zones 9-16 and 17-24 sit on the 2nd and 3rd grouped fixture below, so on a single X21 those cells drive nothing (empty lists).

fx-astera-ax1-pixeltube.page: Product Overview, 'Top view' drawing (sheet 1): '16 Pixel individually controllable' with the '1. Pixel' callout at the end with the protruding end cap; 'Side view' shows that end cap carries the power button and IP65 SiliconeCap. Same drawing in AX1-BTB_AX1_PixelTube_BTB_Manual_EN_DE_IT_ES_FR_CN.pdf.
fx-astera-ax1-pixeltube.orientation: Lying horizontal, power-button/SiliconeCap end cap on the left
fx-astera-ax1-pixeltube.notes: Cell 1 is the pixel at the end cap with the power button and SiliconeCap ('1. Pixel' in the manual's top-view drawing); 16 pixels over 1035 mm. 4- and 8-cell modes are drawn as equal runs of 4 and 2 pixels from that end.

fx-astera-ax2-100-pixelbar.page: Datasheet: Specifications table (Pixels 16), Drawings (top view shows the round lenses), Connections (left = DMX IN / POWER IN), BarConnect+ (62.5 mm pixel pitch). Pixel modes 1/4/8/16 from FP1_FP1-BTB_Titan_Tube_DMX_Profiles_V2.pdf (shared Titan / AX2-100 document).
fx-astera-ax2-100-pixelbar.orientation: Lying horizontal, lenses facing the viewer, DMX IN / powerCON IN end (datasheet 'left') on the left
fx-astera-ax2-100-pixelbar.notes: 16 round lens pixels at 62.5 mm pitch over 1000 mm; no Astera source says which end is cell 1, so it is assumed to be the IN-connector end, matching the Astera tubes. Not in pixel-input.json: cell counts 4/8/16 come from the Titan/AX2-100 DMX profile PDF.

fx-astera-ax2-50-pixelbar.page: Datasheet: Specifications table (Pixels 8), Drawings AX2-50, Connections (left = DMX IN / POWER IN), BarConnect+ (62.5 mm pixel pitch). Pixel modes 1/2/4/8 from FP2_FP2-BTB_Helios_Tube_DMX_Profiles_V2.pdf (shared Helios / AX2-50 document).
fx-astera-ax2-50-pixelbar.orientation: Lying horizontal, lenses facing the viewer, DMX IN / powerCON IN end (datasheet 'left') on the left
fx-astera-ax2-50-pixelbar.notes: 8 round lens pixels at 62.5 mm pitch over 500 mm; no Astera source says which end is cell 1, so it is assumed to be the IN-connector end, matching the Astera tubes. Not in pixel-input.json: cell counts 2/4/8 come from the Helios/AX2-50 DMX profile PDF.

fx-astera-helios-tube.page: Product Overview, 'Top view' drawing (sheet 1): '8 Pixel individually controllable' with the '1. Pixel' callout at the control-panel end.
fx-astera-helios-tube.orientation: Lying horizontal, control-panel end on the left
fx-astera-helios-tube.notes: Cell 1 is the pixel at the control-panel end ('1. Pixel' in the Helios BTB manual's top-view drawing); 8 pixels over 550 mm (datasheet). 2- and 4-cell modes are drawn as equal runs of 4 and 2 pixels from that end.

fx-astera-hydrapanel.page: Sheet 1, 'Product Overview - Front' diagram ('1. Pixel', '6 Pixel individually controllable')
fx-astera-hydrapanel.orientation: Front view, landscape, magnets at the left and right ends as drawn
fx-astera-hydrapanel.notes: Pixel 1 is top-left; arrows run down the left column then down the right column, so 1-3 = left column top to bottom, 4-6 = right column. How the 2 and 3 pixel modes group the 6 physical pixels is not documented, so those counts are left out.

fx-astera-hyperion-tube.page: Product Overview, 'Top view' drawing (sheet 1): '32 Pixel individually controllable' with the '1. Pixel' callout at the control-panel end. Same drawing in FP3-BTB_HyperionTube_BTB_Manual_EN_DE_IT_ES_FR_CN.pdf.
fx-astera-hyperion-tube.orientation: Lying horizontal, control-panel end on the left
fx-astera-hyperion-tube.notes: Cell 1 is the pixel at the control-panel end ('1. Pixel' in the manual's top-view drawing); 32 pixels over 2031 mm. 8- and 16-cell modes are drawn as equal runs of 4 and 2 pixels from that end.

fx-astera-titan-tube.page: Product Overview, 'Top view' drawing (sheet 1): '16 Pixel individually controllable' with the '1. Pixel' callout at the control-panel end. Same drawing in FP1_TitanTube_Manual_EN_DE_IT_ES_FR_CN.pdf.
fx-astera-titan-tube.orientation: Lying horizontal, control-panel end (power button, SiliconCap over the DC socket) on the left
fx-astera-titan-tube.notes: Cell 1 is the pixel at the control-panel end ('1. Pixel' in the manual's top-view drawing); 16 pixels over 1035 mm. 4- and 8-cell modes are drawn as equal runs of 4 and 2 pixels from that end; Astera's 'Turn by 180' app setting reverses the order.

fx-chauvet-maverick-storm-1-wash.page: p.29, "Zones for Pixel Control" (same drawing in the User Manual Rev. 3, p.17)
fx-chauvet-maverick-storm-1-wash.orientation: Front view of the lens as drawn in the DMX chart; the drawing does not say which way the base is
fx-chauvet-maverick-storm-1-wash.notes: Numbered outside in: 1-12 round the outer ring clockwise from the right (just below 3 o'clock), 13-18 round the inner ring clockwise from the lower right, and 19 is the centre. DMX "Red/Green/Blue N" drives zone N.

fx-chauvet-rogue-r2x-wash.orientation: Front view of the lens as drawn in the manual (zone 1 at the top); the drawing does not say which way the base is
fx-chauvet-rogue-r2x-wash.notes: The 5 cells are horizontal bands of the 19-LED cluster, top to bottom: zone 1 = top 6 outer LEDs, 2 = upper 3 inner LEDs, 3 = centre, 4 = lower 3 inner LEDs, 5 = bottom 6 outer LEDs. LED ids are reading order (top to bottom, left to right) because the manual only labels zones, not individual LEDs.

fx-claypaky-b-eye-k20.page: p.30, "A.LEDA B-EYE K20 - LED reference number for pixel mapping"
fx-claypaky-b-eye-k20.orientation: Front view of the lens, tilt channel 16 at 200, base and display at the bottom
fx-claypaky-b-eye-k20.notes: LED 1 is the centre, then rings of 6 (2-7), 12 (8-19) and 18 (20-37), each starting at the bottom-left and running clockwise. The manual draws the rings as concentric circles rather than a strict hex grid, so they are laid out that way; DMX "LED N" drives LED N.

fx-creamsource-vortex24.page: Doc p. 11 (PDF p. 20), 'Zone Orientation' and 'Zone Map'
fx-creamsource-vortex24.orientation: Front view ('Looking at the front of the fixture'), as drawn in the Zone Map
fx-creamsource-vortex24.notes: Zone 1 is top-left, 6 across x 4 down, numbered left to right then down. Grid = 2x2 quadrants; Bars and Split default to vertical stripes from the left, the Zone Orientation channel switches them to horizontal (see altGroups).

fx-creamsource-vortex4.page: Doc p. 11 (PDF p. 20), 'Zone Orientation' and 'Zone Map'
fx-creamsource-vortex4.orientation: Front view ('Looking at the front of the fixture'), as drawn in the Zone Map
fx-creamsource-vortex4.notes: Zone 1 is top-left, 2x2 numbered left to right then down; Multi Zone and Grid modes use those 4 zones. Split and Bars modes (2 cells) default to vertical stripes (zone 1 = left half); the Zone Orientation channel can make them horizontal (zone 1 = top half), see altGroups.

fx-creamsource-vortex8.page: Doc p. 11 (PDF p. 20), 'Zone Orientation' and 'Zone Map'
fx-creamsource-vortex8.orientation: Front view ('Looking at the front of the fixture'), as drawn in the Zone Map
fx-creamsource-vortex8.notes: Zone 1 is top-left, 4 across x 2 down. The 4-cell count is shared by Grid modes (2x2 quadrants, used in groups) and Bars modes (4 vertical bars by default), so Bars layouts are in altGroups; Split (2 cells) defaults to left/right halves.

fx-etc-fos-4-panel.page: fos/4 Panel User Manual v1.4.0, p. 17 'DMX Cell Modes' (text only); sizes p. 40 'Dimensions and Weight'
fx-etc-fos-4-panel.orientation: Landscape, yoke at the short ends as drawn on p. 40; viewing side for left/right not stated
fx-etc-fos-4-panel.notes: Manual says cell modes control 'the left and right sides of the fixture' but gives no diagram, so Cell 1 = left half seen from the front is assumed. Aspect 3.0 is the 8x24 in model (fos4PL8/PD8); the 16x24 in is 1.5 and the 24x24 in is 1.0.

fx-glp-impression-x4-bar-20.page: User manual v1.8 p. 28: 'The Pixel are numbered left to right 1 - 20 as shown below. Tilt DMX Value = 0 / Display to the front / Power & DMX In to the left' with numbered drawing; dual pixel mode tables p. 19-20 (Set 1&2 ... Set 19&20).
fx-glp-impression-x4-bar-20.orientation: Lying horizontal, tilt 0, display to the front, Power / DMX In end on the left
fx-glp-impression-x4-bar-20.notes: Cell 1 is at the Power / DMX In end (manual p. 28); 20 hex lens pixels. Dual Pixel modes have 10 cells of 2 pixels (input said 19), and the 3-cell Normal/HiRes modes are colour layers, not pixel cells, so 3 and 19 are left out.

fx-glp-impression-x4-l.page: p.19, "The Pixel are numbered left to right / top to bottom 1 - 37" drawing
fx-glp-impression-x4-l.orientation: Front view of the lens with tilt DMX value 0 and the display to the left
fx-glp-impression-x4-l.notes: Hex cluster in horizontal rows of 4, 5, 6, 7, 6, 5 and 4, numbered P01-P37 left to right, top to bottom. Cells are pointy-top hexagons, r is the corner radius.

fx-glp-jdc1.page: p.14, "Pixel grouping", Figure 4: LEDs grouped into pixels
fx-glp-jdc1.orientation: Front view of the head with tilt at 000 and the base below, Pixel Orientation and 2nd Plate Pixel Orientation both Normal
fx-glp-jdc1.notes: Plate pixels 1-6 are the top plate and 7-12 the bottom plate, left to right; Beam pixels 1-12 (ids 13-24) run left to right along the centre tube. Rect x and y are the top-left corner; Plate and Plate background drive the same plate pixels.

fx-martin-mac-aura-pxl.orientation: Front view of the lens, fixture hanging, pan at 50%, display and connectors at the back of the fixture (as Figure 2)
fx-martin-mac-aura-pxl.notes: Positions are taken from the label coordinates in the manual figure: Beam 1 is the centre, 2-7 the inner ring and 8-19 the outer ring, clockwise. Aura pixel N has id 19+N (Aura 1 = id 20, Aura 141 = id 160) and sits where the manual prints its number between the beam lenses.

fx-nanlite-pavotube-ii-15x.page: DMX reference guide PIXEL = 4 / 8 tables (PIXEL(1)..PIXEL(8)); user manual 'DMX PIXEL' menu (p. 12); length 600 mm x 43 mm from nanlite.com PavoTube II X/XR product page.
fx-nanlite-pavotube-ii-15x.orientation: Lying horizontal, control panel / DC and DMX socket end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-nanlite-pavotube-ii-15x.notes: 8 pixels (finest DMX mode), 4-cell mode drawn as pairs. Nanlite's DMX guide and manual do not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel/socket end is assumed.

fx-nanlite-pavotube-ii-30x.page: DMX reference guide PIXEL = 4 / 8 / 16 tables (PIXEL(1)..PIXEL(16)); user manual 'DMX PIXEL' menu (p. 12, shows 8 and 16); length 1145 mm x 43 mm from nanlite.com PavoTube II X/XR product page.
fx-nanlite-pavotube-ii-30x.orientation: Lying horizontal, control panel / DC and DMX socket end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-nanlite-pavotube-ii-30x.notes: 16 pixels (finest DMX mode); 4- and 8-cell modes drawn as equal runs of 4 and 2. Nanlite's DMX guide and manual do not say which end is pixel 1, so the control-panel/socket end is assumed.

fx-nanlite-pavotube-t8-7x.page: DMX reference guide PIXEL = 4 / 8 / 16 tables; nanlite.com T8-7X product page: '16 pixels', size 39 x 1002 mm.
fx-nanlite-pavotube-t8-7x.orientation: Lying horizontal, USB-C / control end on the left (assumed cell 1 end)
fx-nanlite-pavotube-t8-7x.notes: 16 pixels over 1002 mm (Nanlite product page); 4- and 8-cell modes drawn as equal runs of 4 and 2. No Nanlite source says which end is pixel 1, so the USB-C/control end is assumed.

fx-robe-spiider.page: p.15, "Pixel control and pixel effects - Pixel order" drawing (zone/ring names from the DMX chart "Background - Active zone" channel, p.53)
fx-robe-spiider.orientation: Front view of the lens, base and display at the bottom (manual drawing at Pan=128, Tilt=235), Pixel Index and Pixel Mirror at factory default
fx-robe-spiider.notes: The 19-pixel order is drawn in the manual: 1 is the centre, 2-7 the inner ring and 8-19 the outer ring, both running clockwise from the bottom-left. The manual does not draw the Mode 1 zones; zone 1 = centre, 2 = inner ring, 3 = outer ring is inferred from Robe naming Ring 1 as the middle pixel elsewhere in the same chart, so only the Zone group is assumed.
